An overrides value that is not an object is reported, not rewritten.
-- changes --
[{"name":"semver","ecosystem":"npm","to":"7.7.2","method":"override","file":"package.json"}]
-- in:package.json --
{
  "name": "app",
  "overrides": "nope"
}
-- skipped --
[
  {
    "change": {
      "name": "semver",
      "ecosystem": "npm",
      "to": "7.7.2",
      "method": "override",
      "file": "package.json"
    },
    "reason": "the section is not a JSON object"
  }
]
